MRI Safety Information
MR Conditional (1.5-Tesla and 3.0-Tesla): SFG ≤ 720 Gauss/cm; slew rate ≤ 150 T/m/s per axis; at 1.5 T: whole body SAR not to exceed 0.4 W/kg, No more than 30 minutes of active scan time per session; at 3 T: B1+rms <= 1 μT; for MR scanners that do not report B1+rms, Whole-Body SAR ≤ 0.1 W/kg; Normal Operating Mode.
